status: Optional bounded Events foundation selected only by NODE_COMPAT_EVENTS=ON; core and Path manifests remain unchanged.
moduleContract: Exactly the16 pinned Node22 ESM names. Default is the callable EventEmitter constructor and equals named EventEmitter and default.EventEmitter. Exported functions share initial identity with default static members. errorMonitor is a unique symbol, captureRejectionSymbol is Symbol.for(nodejs.rejection); captureRejections/usingDomains are false and defaultMaxListeners is10. Static defaultMaxListeners is a mutable accessor while its named ESM export captures10. Selected literal CommonJS lowering will return default; runtime require and syncBuiltinESMExports remain excluded.

node:events.callablePolicy: Listed synchronous methods accept string/symbol event names and ordinary initialized EventEmitter/mixin receivers. Deferred callable exports throw ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call or construction, including during initialization. No Proxy or fabricated host operation.
node:events.unsupportedPrototypePolicy: Only the15 listed EventEmitter prototype methods are claimed. AsyncResource instances cannot be constructed.
deviations: Event-name coercion beyond strings/symbols is explicitly deferred even though Node accepts other property-key values.
Resource caps throw RangeError ERR_SM_NODE_LIMIT while preserving already-registered state; Node has no corresponding fixed caps.
Listener warning thresholds retain advisory behavior and warned markers, but process warning delivery is deferred; no console/stdio import is introduced.
captureRejections=true and its global setter are deferred until correct scheduler/error propagation; false remains supported.
Static once promises, on async iteration, addAbortListener and EventEmitterAsyncResource are explicit throwing stubs.
getEventListeners/getMaxListeners/setMaxListeners support EventEmitter-compatible targets; native EventTarget integration is deferred.
Invalid argument names/codes are matched for tested supported cases; detailed received-value messages and non-Error error-event rendering differ.
Private internal symbol layout, arbitrary external mutation of _events, cross-realm receivers, runtime CommonJS loading and mutable ESM synchronization are not claimed.
